_evidence.spell_line: Removes Fog of War and allows vision anywhere on the map for 3 seconds. (unlimited range; costs 70 MP)
Heals a targeted friendly, organic unit. (range: 6; not usable on caster, costs 6 MP per HP Point healed)
Deals damage to a targeted undead unit. (range: 10; costs 4 MP per HP Point damaged)
Lowers target's movement speed and attack rate (costs: 50 Mana, range: 10)
AoE damage around target unit (costs: 80 Mana, range: 6)
Makes target temporarily invisible until it either attacks or casts a spell (costs: 200 Mana, range: 6)
<u>Permanently</u> turns target into a defenseless critter (costs: 200 Mana, range: 10)
Summons a controllable [[Eye of Kilrogg (Warcraft II)|Eye of Kilrogg]], which can be used to remove Fog of War (costs 70 Mana)

_evidence.spell_line: Puts a powerful buff on a friendly unit, doubling its Basic and Piercing Damage (costs 50 Mana, range: 6)

Summons up to 5 trapped [[Rune magic|runes]] over an area (each deals 50 Piercing Damage if touched; costs 200 Mana, range: 10) (note: runes will not appear on occupied squares, but the spell will cost 40 less Mana for each rune that fails to appear)
Powerful attack that heals back the caster (costs: 100 Mana, range: 10)
Upgrades target's movement speed (and attack rate if [[Dragon (Warcraft II)|Dragon]] or [[Gryphon Rider (Warcraft II)|Gryphon]]) (costs: 50 Mana, range: 6)
Summons the controllable [[Skeleton (Warcraft II)|skeletons]] of up to 5 dead units (costs: 50 Mana per Skeleton, range: 6; affects a very large area)
Summons an uncontrollable but powerful whirlwind over an area (costs: 100 Mana, range: 12)
Damages the target unit but makes it invulnerable for a short time. Does not protect against Polymorph (costs: 200 Mana, range: 6)
